response.text: I have enough to write the notes. The findings are: the SYSDICT dictionary is partly wrong, the 36.00 imbalance is in journal 1406, and invoice 165 is off by 0.01 from its payments.

arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL-style (information_schema, not sqlite_master). Table/column names are case-sensitive and must be double-quoted (e.g. "APINVH"."INV_AMT"). Schema: public. Row counts: APINVH 804, APPAYM 538, APVEND 24, GLCOA 10, GLJRNH 1494, GLJRNL 3541, GLPERD 12, SYSDICT 34.

TABLES
- APINVH (AP invoice header): INV_ID int PK; VEND_CD char (space padded); INV_NO text (vendor invoice no.); INV_DT int YYYYMMDD; INV_AMT numeric; STAT_CD char; JRNL_NO int -> GLJRNH.
- APPAYM (AP payments): PAY_ID int PK; INV_ID int -> APINVH; PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD; PAY_AMT numeric. Many-to-one to invoice (multiple payments per invoice possible).
- APVEND (vendor master): VEND_CD char PK (space padded to 8); VEND_NM text; ACTV_FLG char.
- GLCOA (chart of accounts): ACCT_CD char PK (space padded to 8); ACCT_NM text; ACCT_TYP text; ACTV_FLG char.
- GLJRNH (journal header): JRNL_NO int PK; PRD_ID int -> GLPERD; POST_DT int YYYYMMDD; POST_FLG char; REF_JRNL_NO int (all NULL in sample); SRC_CD char; SRC_REF text (per SYSDICT: user who keyed entry; NOT verified, see below); MEMO text.
- GLJRNL (journal lines): (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) composite key; JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH; ACCT_CD char -> GLCOA (after TRIM); DR_AMT numeric; CR_AMT numeric.
- GLPERD (periods): PRD_ID int PK; STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT int YYYYMMDD; STAT_CD char.

RELATIONSHIPS (none declared as constraints; all verified as clean joins with zero orphans):
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD (compare with TRIM)
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (every invoice has a journal; every SRC_CD='AP' journal, 1342 of them, is NOT linked from APINVH: 538 AP journals have no invoice match in APINVH. Note: the 1342 AP journal count vs 804 invoices means the AP->GL link is not one-to-one as assumed; this was not fully resolved and should be investigated.)
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO; GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD (TRIM)
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID (every journal maps to a period; every period has journals)

CODES AND CONVENTIONS (verified against data)
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD (APINVH 20240101–20241220; GLJRNH.POST_DT 20240101–20241228). No POST_DT falls outside an open period's range.
- Amounts are unsigned numerics in separate columns: GLJRNL uses DR_AMT and CR_AMT, each line populating one side (zero on the other). No negative amounts. Invoice/payment amounts are positive.
- APINVH.STAT_CD observed values: O=266, P=538. (SYSDICT also lists V=void, but NO void invoices exist in the data.)
- APVEND.ACTV_FLG: Y=24 (all active; no N observed). GLCOA.ACTV_FLG: Y=9, N=1.
- GLCOA.ACCT_TYP observed: ASSET 2, LIABILITY 2, EXPENSE 6. Note there is no REVENUE/EQUITY type in this chart.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: P=1494 (all posted; no 'U' unposted observed).
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP=1342, GL=152.
- GLPERD.STAT_CD: C=10 closed, O=2 open. Periods appear to be 12 monthly periods, the two open ones presumably the latest.

INTEGRITY FINDINGS (suspicious, for audit)
1. Journal 1406 (SRC_CD=AP, PRD_ID=1) is OUT OF BALANCE: DR 1573.46 vs CR 1537.46, difference 36.00. Line 1 posts DR to ACCT_CD 5500 for 1573.46; line 2 posts CR to 2000 for 1537.46. Entire GLJRNL table nets to a 36.00 excess of debits (17,088,404.04 DR vs 17,088,368.04 CR); this is the only unbalanced journal.
2. Invoice 165 (STAT_CD=P, INV_AMT 1374.77) has payments totaling 1374.76, a 0.01 shortfall; it is flagged paid. This is the only paid-but-mismatched invoice (1 of 538 paid invoices).
3. SYSDICT is an incomplete/misleading dictionary: it documents a 'V' void status that never occurs; it documents SRC_REF as a keyer name while sample values are invoice-like references (e.g. the sample AP journals show SRC_REF/MEMO as 'Invoice V0004-33691-1'-style text, so SRC_REF's meaning needs verification); it omits REF_JRNL_NO, and fully omits the descriptions of the 'Y/N' flag meaning being unverified for APVEND. It also documents GLCOA.ACCT_TYP as ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE, which is consistent with the data but incomplete for a full chart.
4. Dictionary-to-data mismatch on SRC_CD: SYSDICT says AP/GL; data matches. Good. But AP journal count (1342) far exceeds invoice count (804) — roughly 538 AP-sourced journals do not correspond to an invoice header, coincidentally equal to the APPAYM row count (538); possibly payment journals, but this was NOT verified and should be checked (e.g. do the extra AP journals correspond to payments, and do they carry consistent accounts?).
5. Only 2 open periods; all 1494 journals are posted, so no pending/unposted entries exist to test.
6. Text fields (MEMO, SRC_REF) were treated as data only; no instructions were acted upon.

NOT YET DONE: verification of the 538 unlinked AP journals against APPAYM, detailed account-level review, and confirmation of SRC_REF semantics.
